profile.headline: Calico Life Sciences | Engineering @ UC Berkeley
profile.summary: Ambitious, creative, and versatile UC Berkeley Engineering graduate with experience in the fast-paced biotech industry. Motivated to drive the feasibility of health and wellness for all through biomedical engineering applications, in a time when there are increasing needs and concerns to be addressed and overcome. Formerly a key member in the Molecular Biology R&D team at TL Biolabs, which seeks to provide an affordable genomic testing platform for STI detection, and where I have broadened my scientific expertise into identifying antibiotic resistant strains of pathogens. I am excited to tackle the unpredictable and passionate about solutions that bring the future closer.

positions.title: Research Assistant & Lab Manager
positions.description:
● Key member in the R&D of a genomic testing platform to identify antibiotic resistant strains of pathogens from back to front – including troubleshooting, optimization, quality assessment, analysis, documentation, and presentation of the complete pipeline.
● Daily multidisciplinary collaboration with other teams (chemistry, engineering, microfluidics, production & software) to give input, feedback, progress, and relevant data to ensure that the various pieces of each infrastructure is running smoothly.
● Key contributor in evaluating potential hires for the Molecular Biology team – discuss reviews with CEO, COO, CSO & team lead. Successfully onboard & train new research assistants throughout the entire pipeline.
● Aid in setting up a lab for infectious samples, which is recently BSL2-certified and now awaiting CLIA validation based on STI sensitivity & specificity data submitted from experiments.
● Seek out on-site meetings with vendors to scope out systems that could streamline our processes. Directly worked with OpenTrons Co-Founder Will Canine to set up pipetting robot, designed & 3D printed custom parts for specialized lab equipment not available for purchase.
● Manage lab operations. Includes engineering cost-effective solutions to maximize efficiency, maintenance of various lab equipment, product & reagent research, keeping inventory, ordering, negotiations with vendors, and ensuring OSHA standards are met.

projects.title: Measuring Nasal Airflow for Deviated Septum
projects.description:
● Designed a preliminary diagnostic device for patients with a deviated septum and sleep apnea
● Measured respiratory rate and nasal airflow velocity using thermistor
● Built and debugged the circuit: Wheatstone, instrumentation amplifier, 2nd  order low-pass filter, ADC
● Optimized noise matching and suppressed 60 Hz interference for clean results

projects.title: Design & Optimization of Knee Prosthesis
projects.description:
● Determined causes of failure in knee replacements are due to wear and fatigue
● Analyzed bending stresses and strain in the tibial and trabecular components
● Analyzed contact stresses between the femoral and tibial components
● Modified design variables and material properties to optimize knee prosthesis
